description: Source code for the TbCheckMessageNode class, a rule engine component in Thingsboard that checks for the presence of specified fields in message data and metadata.

classes.name: TbCheckMessageNode
classes.description: A rule engine node that checks for the presence of specified fields in message data and metadata.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, parsing message and metadata field lists.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, determines relation type based on field presence, and forwards or fails accordingly.

methods.name: allKeysData
methods.description: Checks if all specified message data fields are present.

methods.name: allKeysMetadata
methods.description: Checks if all specified metadata fields are present.

methods.name: atLeastOneData
methods.description: Checks if at least one specified message data field is present.

methods.name: atLeastOneMetadata
methods.description: Checks if at least one specified metadata field is present.

methods.name: processAllKeys
methods.description: Helper to verify all fields are present in the map.

methods.name: processAtLeastOne
methods.description: Helper to verify at least one field is present in the map.

methods.name: metadataToMap
methods.description: Converts message metadata to a Map.

methods.name: dataToMap
methods.description: Converts message data JSON to a Map.
